adjudication_basis: Manifest validation_url goldens plus independent exact-head source inspection

goldens.claim: Negative slicing on Django QuerySets raises at runtime

model_results.summary: Critical runtime bugs: undefined variable and unsupported negative queryset slicing

findings.title: Undefined variable organization_context causes NameError
findings.body: organization_context is not defined in the shown function scope.

findings.title: Negative queryset slicing is unsupported and crashes
findings.body: The exact head passes cursor.offset < 0 into queryset[start_offset:stop], which Django QuerySets reject.

findings.title: Same negative-offset slicing bug in DateTimePaginator modification
findings.body: The reviewer claimed a related prev-cursor path may retain a negative offset.

model_results.summary: Potential security and correctness issues in pagination optimization

findings.title: Insecure Direct Object Reference risk in negative offset pagination
findings.body: The reviewer alleged a permission-boundary risk but did not identify the golden runtime exception.

findings.title: Missing input validation for pagination parameters
findings.body: The reviewer requested stricter boolean validation.

findings.title: Inconsistent boundary handling in negative offset logic
findings.body: The reviewer cited incorrect results or performance, not the validated QuerySet crash.

findings.title: Missing test coverage for security-critical pagination features
findings.body: The reviewer requested negative-offset and permission-boundary tests.

goldens.claim: CountDevices followed by a separate insert is a TOCTOU race

model_results.summary: Device-limit logic can fail authentication and is racy

findings.title: Misused error return in updateDevice
findings.body: No affected row is conflated with reaching the device limit.

findings.title: Beyond-limit new devices fail authentication
findings.body: A new device can turn the tracking quota into a hard authentication error.

findings.title: Synchronous TagDevice in auth path
findings.body: The reviewer identified blocking database work in Authenticate.

findings.title: Count plus update is racy
findings.body: CountDevices and the later insert use separate sessions without a transaction.

model_results.summary: The configurable device limit has implementation concerns

findings.title: Inconsistent error handling in device limit enforcement
findings.body: No affected row is conflated with reaching the device limit.

findings.title: Race condition in device counting
findings.body: Another request can insert between CountDevices and this request's insert.

findings.title: Missing validation for device limit configuration
findings.body: The reviewer requested rejection of negative limit values.

findings.title: Inconsistent error propagation in client
findings.body: The reviewer described inconsistent handling of device-limit errors.

findings.title: Missing test coverage for edge cases
findings.body: The reviewer requested zero, negative, concurrency, and update cases.

findings.title: Hardcoded expiration period
findings.body: The reviewer requested a configurable or documented expiration period.
